introHtml: Dishwasher safe multi function tools are built to withstand frequent cleaning without rust or wear, making them ideal for restaurant staff, catering teams, or any workplace where hygiene matters. Unlike standard tools that require hand washing, these can go straight into the commercial dishwasher after a long shift. With options for full-color logo imprinting on durable stainless steel or heat-resistant nylon, your brand stays visible through hundreds of cycles. Perfect for safety managers equipping kitchen crews or HR directors creating welcome kits for food service staff.
